description: This file defines the LeavePeriodHistoryModel class in the OrangeHRM system, which acts as a data model for API responses related to leave period histories. It includes metadata annotations for API schema generation and uses traits for serialization. The class encapsulates a LeavePeriodHistory entity and specifies filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
